title: Independent Human Design-Data Review and Freeze Receipt
description: Separate, human-supplied confirmation for design-data delivery. Provided by the caller as its own input; an agent must never generate it. This is a syntactic and process gate only: it does not prove that a real human acted in the real world — the caller is responsible for supplying a genuine human record. Hash bindings void the review whenever the ledger, frozen values, wording bindings, or confirmed artifact bindings change.

reviewed_by.description: Must identify a human; agent, model, bot, and system labels are rejected by the same boundary as the ARCH-122 copy review.

ledger_canonical_sha256.description: Order-insensitive canonical hash of the whole reviewed ledger; any ledger edit voids this review.

frozen_data_bindings.description: Every COORDINATED/FROZEN_FOR_DELIVERY data value confirmed by the human; any value or wording change voids the review.

public_wording_bindings_sha256.description: Canonical hash of the ledger copy_bindings section; any page/copy binding change voids the review.

input_bindings_sha256.description: Canonical hash of the artifact's build-time input binding (provenance inputs or built_from data hashes).

items.description: Required for every non-deterministic artifact: a human confirms this exact input/output combination.

findings_sha256.description: Canonical hash of findings plus findings_resolutions, binding the record to itself.
